eyebrow: Three ways to ship a model

steps.label: Self-hosted
steps.sub: You buy or rent GPUs, install the serving stack, patch it forever

steps.label: Cloud AI platform
steps.sub: Microsoft/AWS/Google runs the model, you call an API

steps.label: Fully managed SaaS
steps.sub: A product built on top of a model, no infra decisions at all

steps.label: Elastic compute
steps.sub: GPU capacity you don't own, procure, or cool

steps.label: A model catalog
steps.sub: OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, and more behind one contract

steps.label: Governance
steps.sub: Content filters, RBAC, logging built in, not bolted on

steps.label: One bill
steps.sub: Pay-per-token instead of a depreciating GPU cluster
